new_cards.claim: GDT712 reduces the exact wholeform cheol to trockenes Material, removing the unsupported drug identity. The source retains a nominal material head and dry-state working role, but the active singleton supplies no free CH/E/OL meanings. This is distinct from both the older trockener Drogenstoff reading and GDT750’s two local dry-state assignments.

GDT712 gives ches the lexical core trocken, Mittelstufe and only locally renders trockenes Material, Mittelstufe. The former drug head is removed; the singleton leaves material identity and final S open. Dry/middle working tags neither settle the S-form rival nor independently identify the content.

GDT712 narrows cholches to nachgetrocknet, Mittelstufe, with nachgetrocknetes Material, Mittelstufe as local realization. Drug identity is removed. The after-drying interpretation remains a learned wholeform proposal; doubled dry structure and an alternate chol|ches boundary do not export an internal temporal-composition rule.

GDT712 gives dolkain the wholeform core abgemessen und heiß; Wert II, separating it from the local abgemessenes heißes Material, Stufe II. Drug identity, exact internal boundary and the substantive value axis remain open in the active singleton; the source does not establish a physical unit or free DOLK/AIN meanings.

GDT712 gives keeaiin the wholeform core heiß, Endstufe; Wert III and locally renders heiß, Endstufe III. Unlike the earlier vollständig erhitzt, Stufe III wording, abstract value and local axis remain separate. The missing terminal Y prevents a free K/EE/AIIN cross-grid export; patient and value axis remain open.

GDT712 gives qotaiin the wholeform core kalt; Wert III and keeps kalt, Grad III only as its local realization. The active singleton leaves the value axis and QO role open; QO/T/AIIN remain bound analytical fields. The older chaiin–qotaiin dry/cold degree-III pair does not establish this axis-open portable core.

GDT715 assigns the complete aiiin core Wert IV, with Menge IV selected only at P052. Its IV value is a working wholeform hypothesis distinct from the old bare STUFE proposal; neither an all-occurrences amount axis nor a free I-count number translation is established.

GDT715 assigns ydaiin the complete core Bezugswert III and locally renders davon: Wert III. It expressly removes drei and Maße from the portable core, retaining a reference/value hypothesis without a named unit or globally fixed count axis. The older davon drei Maße reading remains a separate historical rival.

GDT715 assigns qckhedy the portable action core bis zur Mittelstufe fertig aufbereiten. The preceding dry batch is a local patient hypothesis, outside the word core. This proposes a complete-word preparation action to middle stage without exporting a CKH component meaning or independently proving the action.

GDT715 reduces qey to the portable action core anschließend nehmen. The preceding dry middle-stage portion belongs only to its licensed local realization; it is not a lexical patient inside qey. This scope differs from the older whole reading die vorstehende Mittelstufenportion anschließend nehmen.

GDT715 assigns qochedain the portable core Trockenwert II auf Mittelstufe abmessen. Its local hiervon die Trockenmenge II auf Mittelstufe abmessen supplies the reference and amount realization. The older two-dose/material reading remains distinct; II, dose identity and QO/CH/DAIN exports are not independently confirmed.

GDT715 assigns yky the whole-word action core leicht erhitzen. A hot portion at stage III and the local nachwärmen interpretation are occurrence-bound patients/context, not part of that portable core. Existing Y+K+Y packaging and yky|d readings do not identify this heating action.

GDT715 separates five portable action cores from five selected left-context patients: dold measures/completes this flower; qckhedy prepares the preceding dry batch to middle stage; qey takes the preceding dry middle-stage portion; qochedain measures the referenced dry amount II at middle stage; yky gently reheats the hot portion at stage III. These are local patient hypotheses, not lexical nouns inside the action forms. The f7r.2 dold/flower assignment is retained explicitly; no old result edge or universal nearest-patient rule is automatically confirmed.

GDT716 applies one bounded indexed-share composition to aiir, oar, oair, otar, otarar, otardy, qodar, qokaiir, char, chair, chdar, kard and qochar: R selects the indexed share while state, frame or an explicit wholeform action remains. Concrete material patients stay local; generic Droge is removed from the thirteen cores. Oar/oair and char/chair retain I/II contrasts, and otarar retains share/subshare nesting. This explicit core/local map extends the existing GDT693 common-head policy without a free ar/R translation, a new numeric proof or a bonus for fluent wording.
